caption:
Booked your first physio appointment and not sure what happens once you walk in? Mr Turtle was nervous too.

It starts with your story: your symptoms, how they began, your health history and what you want to get back to. Then your physio looks at how you move, with range, strength and specific tests explained as you go.

Next comes a plain-English explanation of what's likely going on, then some treatment. You'll leave with a few key exercises and a rough plan. If anything needs your GP or imaging, we'll tell you.

Wear comfy clothes and bring any scans. Our team at Hybrid Physio takes the time to listen. Book online via the link in bio 🐢

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
